WITH RECURSIVE pm_team AS ( SELECT ud.user_id FROM user_departments ud WHERE ud.supervisor_id = #{pmId, jdbcType=OTHER} UNION ALL SELECT ud.user_id FROM user_departments ud INNER JOIN pm_team pt ON ud.supervisor_id = pt.user_id ) SELECT ka.id AS assignment_id, ka.cycle_id AS cycle_id, ka.user_id AS user_id, u.full_name AS user_full_name, km.name AS kpi_name, ki.target_description AS target_description, ki.weight AS weight, kc.name AS category_name, km.type_code AS type_code, ka.created_at AS requested_at FROM kpi_assignments ka JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN users u ON ka.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.user_id IS NOT NULL AND ka.status_code = 402 AND ka.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM pm_team) ORDER BY ka.created_at DESC
